_comment: Optional institute location map. Keys are institute names exactly as they appear in the JoSAA data. Filling this in enables the Home State / Other State quota filter and the state filter on the results page. Institutes left out here are shown with location 'Not available' and their HS/OS rows are kept rather than guessed at. Example: "National Institute of Technology Agartala": { "state": "Tripura", "city": "Agartala" }
